PROP-e5782b58-pre-008.text: Non-admin users must only access their own attendance records; IDOR on user_id must be prevented.
PROP-e5782b58-pre-008.assertion: forall query(user, target_user_id): user.is_admin == false => target_user_id == user.id

locations.note: User data is fetched using user.id from supabase.auth.getUser() (session-bound, line 52). No user_id query parameter accepted from the request — IDOR is structurally prevented for the member profile view.
Returns user data from JWT token payload (sub/discord_id). Non-admin users can only access their own data via a valid JWT they own.
